newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 35 dead in clashes with Kurd rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 35 dead in clashes with Kurd rebels.

text.p: Thirty-two Kurdish rebels and three Turkish soldiers have died in the latest clashes in the country's southeast, security officials said on Friday.
Troops killed 32 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in Diyarbakir, Hakkari, Sirnak and Tunceli provinces on Thursday, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement.

The statement, making no mention of army casualties, said among the guerrillas killed were those believed to have killed four Turkish teachers this week. The PKK has denied its rebels killed the teachers, blaming security forces for the deaths.
Earlier a security official told Reuters that three Turkish soldiers were killed by PKK guerrillas in two separate clashes on Thursday night in Tunceli province.
He said around 5,000 Turkish soldiers launched an operation backed by helicopter gunships in search of PKK rebels following the fighting.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in the PKK's 12-year-old armed struggle for autonomy or independence in the country's mainly Kurdish southeast.
